units.source_text: 我對人類的恐懼，跟以往相比，有過之而無不及，

en.t: My fear of human beings was, if anything, even greater than before,

units.source_text: 它在我的心中劇烈地蠕動，而且我的演技日漸長進，

en.t: it writhed violently inside my heart, and my acting improved day by day,

units.source_text: 常常在教室裡逗得同學們笑聲一片，

en.t: I would often make my classmates burst into laughter in the classroom,

units.source_text: 連老師也一邊感嘆「這個班要是沒有大庭，該會是多好的班啊」，

en.t: even the teacher would lament, 'What a fine class this would be if only Oba were not in it,'
while covering his mouth with his hand and laughing.

units.source_text: 甚至那位嗓門如雷的駐校軍官，我也輕而易舉地逗得他噴口大笑過。

en.t: I even managed, with ease, to make the school military officer with the thunderous voice burst out laughing.

units.source_text: 當我正要為完全掩飾自己的真實面目而暗自慶幸時，

en.t: Just as I was secretly beginning to feel relieved that I had completely hidden my true self,

units.source_text: 意想不到地被誰的手指從背後戳了一下。

en.t: unexpectedly, someone jabbed me in the back with a finger.
